enableInstantDrag.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Instant Drag", "hint":"Enable this to allow the Interactable to instantly be dragged on trigger rather than obeying the Interactor's drag threshold."}

useFilteredPinch.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Filtered Pinch", "hint":"Determines if the Interactable should listen to filtered pinch events when targeted by a HandInteractor. Filtered pinch events are more stable when the hand is quickly moving but may add latency in non-moving cases. Most interactions should use raw pinch events by default. Spatial interactions with large hand movement (such as dragging, scrolling) should use filtered pinch events. If an Interactable has a parent Interactable that uses filtered pinch events, this Interactable will also use filtered pinch events."}

acceptableXDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"X", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the X-axis:
- None: Disables X-axis poke detection.
- Right: Finger must approach from +X direction.
- Left: Finger must approach from -X direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Right", "value":1}, {"label":"Left", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

acceptableYDirections.uiInfo:

- None: Disables Y-axis poke detection.

allowMultipleInteractors.uiInfo: {"label":"Allow Multiple Interactors", "hint":"Determines whether this Interactable can be simultaneously controlled by multiple Interactors. When false, only one Interactor type (e.g., left hand or right hand) can interact at a time. Set to true to enable interactions from multiple sources simultaneously, such as allowing both hands to manipulate the Interactable at once."}

isScrollable.uiInfo: {"label":"Is Scrollable", "hint":"When true, interactions with this element can scroll a parent ScrollView that has content extending beyond its visible bounds."}

{"label":"Targeting Mode", "hint":"Defines how Interactors can target and interact with this Interactable. Options include:
- Direct: Only allows close pinch interactions where a hand directly touches the Interactable.
- Indirect: Allows interactions from a distance with raycasting.
- Direct/Indirect: Supports both direct and indirect interaction methods.
- Poke: Enables finger poking interactions.
- All: Supports all targeting modes (Direct, Indirect, and Poke).", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Direct", "value":1}, {"label":"Indirect", "value":2}, {"label":"Direct/Indirect", "value":3}, {"label":"Poke", "value":4}, {"label":"All", "value":7}]}

  like "I'm at step 4, what do I do?" — Gemini will respond using the image and
   the full descaling knowledge, and the panel will auto-jump to the detected
  step if you're in AUTO mode.                                                

  On device:

  Remove testTexture. Press the mic button, ask a question while looking at    
  your machine. Gemini analyzes the live camera frame, places AR labels on
  relevant parts, and the panel tracks your step automatically.

  the mode toggle to switch between MANUAL and AUTO.
